label: Visual Direction
purpose: Strengthen the visual concept behind generated UGC with clearer composition, mood, styling, and detail emphasis.

composition_rules: call out framing, subject emphasis, and scene-level visual hierarchy
make the product or transformation visually legible
mood_direction: define a clear aesthetic mood rather than generic 'high quality' language
align lighting, texture, and color choices with the niche and brand
detail_focus: show tactile details, proof moments, or lifestyle context that make the output feel real
use concrete visual references instead of abstract beauty words

forbidden_patterns: visual instructions with no product focus
style adjectives without concrete image cues
